svg.title: 48-pin CMC connector pinout with high-current cavities
svg.desc: Connector drawn as 12 columns, AA through AM, by 4 rows. Columns AL and AM use wider cavities with heavier outlines to indicate high-current terminals; the remaining ten columns are standard low-current cavities. Columns AA to AE are unpopulated. AF carries PWM fan, PWM2, radiator outlet temperature and a sensor ground. AG is four sensor grounds. AH carries ambient, radiator inlet, battery and powertrain temperatures. AJ carries cabin cool, cabin heat left, cabin heat right and preheat digital inputs. AK carries CAN low and CAN high. AL1 is T15 key-on. AM1 is switched 12 volt supply and AM2 is power ground.
